claims: PlayStation Plus is a subscription service for PlayStation consoles.
Essential, Extra, and Premium.
The Essential tier of PlayStation Plus is priced at $9.99/mo, $24.99/3 mo, $79.99/yr (USD).
The Essential tier of PlayStation Plus includes online multiplayer.
The Essential tier of PlayStation Plus includes two or three monthly games.
The Essential tier of PlayStation Plus includes exclusive discounts.
The Essential tier of PlayStation Plus includes cloud storage.
The Extra tier of PlayStation Plus is priced at $14.99/mo, $39.99/3 mo, $134.99/yr (USD).
The Extra tier of PlayStation Plus includes all Essential benefits.
The Extra tier of PlayStation Plus includes a catalog of up to 400+ downloadable PS4 and PS5 games.
The Premium/Deluxe tier of PlayStation Plus is priced at $17.99/mo, $49.99/3 mo, $159.99/yr (USD).
The Premium/Deluxe tier of PlayStation Plus includes all Extra benefits.
The Premium/Deluxe tier of PlayStation Plus includes a Classics Catalog (PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP).
The Premium/Deluxe tier of PlayStation Plus includes game trials.
The Premium/Deluxe tier of PlayStation Plus includes cloud streaming for select games.
PlayStation Plus users can add new games to their library each month.
PlayStation Plus provides access to hundreds of downloadable PS4 and PS5 titles through the game catalog.
The PlayStation Plus game catalog includes Ubisoft+ Classics.
PlayStation Plus cloud streaming allows streaming games directly to a PS5 or PC.
PlayStation Plus cloud streaming is Premium only.
PlayStation Plus provides access to members-only deals, discounts, and in-game items.
Effective January 2026, Sony has shifted focus toward offering more PS5 games as part of the PlayStation Plus monthly benefits.
Effective January 2026, Sony has reduced the frequency of PS4 game offerings in PlayStation Plus monthly benefits.
